purpose: Choose credible ways for new players to find and play Mythical Void without inventing reach, weakening safety, or publishing through an account Kevin has not approved.

ranking.name: Google Search Console and the owned website
ranking.whyNow: The useful discovery pages and sitemap are already live, so this is the lowest-risk way to learn whether Google can find them.
ranking.nextAction: Kevin verifies mythicalvoid.com in Search Console; then submit https://mythicalvoid.com/sitemap.xml and inspect the four discovery pages.
gates: Kevin must sign in to the relevant Google account
Do not claim indexing, rank or search traffic until Search Console provides evidence

ranking.name: itch.io
ranking.whyNow: It supports browser games, the present build fits its published size and file-count ceilings, and it gives us a game page suited to screenshots, a trailer and honest development context.
ranking.cost: free account; optional payments or donations require a separate decision
ranking.nextAction: Create a portable itch build, test it in the itch frame, then let Kevin review the prepared listing before account creation or publication.
gates: Replace root-absolute build paths with portable relative paths
Keep hosted AI media and other Netlify-only services out of the portable release or provide a safe fallback
Test saves, controls, audio, fullscreen and mobile behavior inside the platform frame
Kevin must approve account creation and the final public page

ranking.name: Imirt
ranking.whyNow: It is an Irish game-maker network with a company directory, events and visibility opportunities. That is a better near-term credibility route than pretending the studio already has a large social audience.
ranking.cost: EUR 100 per year for the published 1-3 FTE corporate tier as observed on 2026-08-14
ranking.nextAction: Kevin decides whether the membership is worth EUR 100, then supplies the legal company details needed for a truthful application.
gates: Kevin confirms the correct legal company name and team size
Recheck the current membership page immediately before payment

ranking.name: CrazyGames
ranking.whyNow: Phaser is supported and the overall build is below the published total ceiling, but the initial download, platform integration and audience fit all need deliberate work.
ranking.cost: no submission fee identified; commercial and SDK terms require fresh review
ranking.nextAction: Only prepare a submission after a portable build exists, initial download is measured, the release is assessed against PEGI 12, and the positioning is confirmed as a general-audience adventure rather than child-targeted content.
gates: Their published audience is 13+ and games must meet PEGI 12 requirements
Their FAQ says content targeted for kids may be rejected, which creates a real positioning risk
Initial download must be measured rather than inferred from total build size
Three cover formats and preview videos are required
Kevin approves submission and any platform agreement

ranking.name: Poki
ranking.whyNow: It is a meaningful browser-game destination and supports Phaser, but Mythical Void is currently far above its recommended total download size.
ranking.cost: commercial terms require fresh review before any submission
ranking.nextAction: Reconsider only after a dedicated lightweight web edition or major asset-streaming pass brings the build close to the published guidance.
gates: Published guidance recommends no more than 5 MB initial download and 8 MB total
Current generated build is roughly 50 MB total
Kevin approves submission and any partner agreement

truthBoundaries: A platform listing is not proof of traffic, players or commercial success.
No reach, ranking, conversion or revenue forecast is approved.
Do not describe Mythical Void as officially connected to NASA.
Do not promise that every creature is globally unique.
Do not use a child account to create, submit or manage a platform listing.
Recheck platform rules, prices and contracts immediately before an external action.
